units.source_text: 女人冲着探出头来骂人的美国兵的脸，狠狠地扇了一记耳光。

en.t: The woman slapped the American soldier hard across the face as he stuck his head out and shouted abuse.

units.source_text: 然后她调头拔腿就跑，脚蹬高跟鞋沿着神路向人口处跑去了。

en.t: Then she turned and ran off, hurrying in her high heels along the shrine path toward the entrance.
